shell_syntax.stdin:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p hosted-results
exec > >(tee hosted-results/build.log) 2>&1
if ! command -v g++-14; then
  timeout 60s sudo apt-get update
  timeout 60s sudo apt-get install -y g++-14
fi
command -v g++-14
g++-14 --version
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, re
from pathlib import Path
p = json.loads(Path('.github/hosted-strength/protocol.json').read_text())
for key in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
    value = os.environ[key.upper() + '_SHA']
    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', value), 'Unfrozen source SHA'
    assert p[key + '_sha'] == value, 'Workflow/protocol SHA mismatch'
PY
for label in baseline candidate; do
  if [ "$label" = baseline ]; then rev="$BASELINE_SHA"; else rev="$CANDIDATE_SHA"; fi
  mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/src-$label"
  git cat-file -e "$rev^{commit}"
  git archive "$rev" | tar -x -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/src-$label"
  cmake -S "$RUNNER_TEMP/src-$label" -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-14 -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS= -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE='-O3 -DNDEBUG -march=x86-64-v3 -mtune=generic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off' -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
  cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label" -j2
  ctest_rc=0
  ctest --test-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label" --output-on-failure || ctest_rc=$?
  cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log" "hosted-results/$label-LastTest.log"
  python3 - "$label" "$rev" <<'PYBUILD'
import hashlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
label, commit = sys.argv[1:]
src = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / ('src-' + label)
build = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / ('build-' + label)
files = [src / 'CMakeLists.txt'] + [p for d in ('src','include','tests') for p in (src/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record = {'source_commit': commit, 'exported_source_sha256': {p.relative_to(src).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in sorted(files)}, 'built_artifacts_sha256': {name: digest(build/name) for name in ('forge','libforge_core.a')}, 'last_test_log_sha256': digest(build/'Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log')}
Path('hosted-results/'+label+'-build-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
PYBUILD
  test "$ctest_rc" = 0
  cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label/compile_commands.json" "hosted-results/$label-compile-commands.json"
  cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-$label/CMakeCache.txt" "hosted-results/$label-CMakeCache.txt"
done
git clone https://github.com/Disservin/fastchess.git "$RUNNER_TEMP/fastchess"
git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/fastchess" checkout --detach "$FASTCHESS_SHA"
test "$(git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/fastchess" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FASTCHESS_SHA"
make -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/fastchess" -j2 CXX=g++-14
"$RUNNER_TEMP/fastchess/fastchess" -version
cp .github/hosted-strength/protocol.json hosted-results/
cp .github/hosted-strength/provenance/openings-selection.json hosted-results/

set -euo pipefail
branch="results/hosted-strength-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
mkdir -p hosted-results
git switch --orphan "$branch"
git rm -rf --cached --ignore-unmatch . >/dev/null
git add -f hosted-results
git -c user.name='Forge validation CI' -c user.email='forge-validation@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m "Preserve bounded native Linux pilot $GITHUB_RUN_ID attempt $GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
